instructions: Does the operator's message name a specific target (file path, function, identifier, URL, command, error message), rather than asking the agent to figure out what to work on?

criteria.true: the message names at least one concrete target the agent can look up or operate on
criteria.false: the message points at no specific file, function, error, or artefact

instructions: Is the operator's intended outcome stated explicitly in this message, or only implied?

options.label: stated
options.criterion: the message says what the operator wants done or known when the agent is finished

options.label: implied
options.criterion: the message gives inputs but leaves the desired outcome for the agent to guess

options.label: cannot_tell
options.criterion: the message is too short to tell whether an outcome is implied or stated

instructions: Does the operator's message include any condition that would let the agent tell when the task is done (e.g. 'output X', 'exit code 0', 'no warnings', 'matches this regex')?

criteria.true: the message contains at least one verifiable condition or expected output
criteria.false: no verifiable success condition is given

instructions: Does the operator's message name any constraints the agent must respect (language, version, branch, file to leave alone, behaviour to avoid), or is it unconstrained?

options.label: constrained
options.criterion: the message names at least one constraint that limits how the task may be done

options.label: unconstrained
options.criterion: no constraint is named and the agent has free choice of approach

options.label: cannot_tell
options.criterion: the message is too short to tell whether constraints are present

instructions: How bounded is the scope of what the operator is asking for? A narrow scope is one task on one target; a wide scope asks for an open-ended investigation.

options.label: narrow
options.criterion: the request targets one artefact and one change

options.label: broad
options.criterion: the request asks for a survey, a refactor, or an investigation with no clear stopping point

options.label: cannot_tell
options.criterion: the request is too vague to bound

instructions: Are the requirements in this message internally consistent, or do they contradict each other (asking both to add a feature and to make no changes, asking for both Python 2 and Python 3, etc.)?

criteria.true: the requirements in the message do not contradict each other
criteria.false: the message contains at least one pair of requirements that cannot both be satisfied

instructions: Does this message build on the prior transcript in a coherent way, or does it ignore what was just said?

options.label: coherent
options.criterion: the message responds to, refines, or follows up on the agent's last turn or a tool result

options.label: disconnected
options.criterion: the message starts a brand-new topic with no link to the prior exchange

options.label: first_turn
options.criterion: this is the first operator message, so there is no prior exchange to relate to

options.label: cannot_tell
options.criterion: the transcript does not show enough context to judge coherence

instructions: Could a competent agent act on this message without needing to ask a clarifying question first?

options.label: actable
options.criterion: the message gives enough information for an agent to begin work without asking

options.label: needs_clarification
options.criterion: at least one obvious clarifying question is required before work can begin

options.label: cannot_tell
options.criterion: the message is too short or technical to decide
